```{julia}
#| output: false
#| echo: false

# Libraries
using CSV
using DataFrames
using FASTX
using PlotlyJS
using StatsBase
using Statistics

# Functions
function getcors(x1,x2)
    temp_df = DataFrame("x1" => x1, "x2" => x2)
    filter!(row -> !isnan(row.x1) && !isnan(row.x2), temp_df)
    temp_df.x1 = Float64.(temp_df.x1)
    temp_df.x2 = Float64.(temp_df.x2)
    return corspearman(temp_df.x1, temp_df.x2)
end

function getcorl(x1,x2)
    temp_df = DataFrame("x1" => x1, "x2" => x2)
    filter!(row -> !isnan(row.x1) && !isnan(row.x2), temp_df)
    temp_df.x1 = Float64.(temp_df.x1)
    temp_df.x2 = Float64.(temp_df.x2)
    return cor(temp_df.x1, temp_df.x2)
end

function tomap(df::DataFrame)
    dict = Dict()
    for i in 1:nrow(df)
        gid = df[i,1]
        pid = df[i,2]
        dict[gid * "-" * pid] = (df[i,3],df[i,4])
        dict[pid * "-" * gid] = (df[i,3],df[i,4])
    end
    return dict
end

function rankrank(x1, x2, skipzeros=false)
    temp_df = DataFrame("x1" => x1, "x2" => x2)
    filter!(row -> !isnan(row.x1) && !isnan(row.x2), temp_df)
    temp_df.x1 = Float64.(temp_df.x1)
    temp_df.x2 = Float64.(temp_df.x2)
    if skipzeros
        filter!(row -> row.x1 > 0 && row.x2 > 0, temp_df)
    end
    temp_df.x1_rank = ordinalrank(temp_df.x1)
    temp_df.x2_rank = ordinalrank(temp_df.x2)
    return plot(
        scatter(x=temp_df.x1_rank, y=temp_df.x2_rank, mode="markers"),
        Layout(xaxis_title="YN00 dS rank", yaxis_title="Ensembl dS rank")
    )
end

function parse_with_na(str)
    if ismissing(str)
        return NaN64
    elseif isa(str, Number)
        return str
    end
    if lowercase(str) == "na"      ||
       lowercase(str) == "missing" ||
       str == ""
        return NaN64
    else
        return parse(Float64, str)
    end
end

function deduplicate(
    df::DataFrame, 
    seq1_idx::Int=1,
    seq2_idx::Int=2,
    dS_idx::Int=3
    )
    dict = Dict{String, Float64}()
    errors = Set{Tuple{String, String}}()
    for i in 1:nrow(df)
        s1 = String(df[i,seq1_idx])
        s2 = String(df[i,seq2_idx])
        dS = typeof(df[i, dS_idx]) <: AbstractString ? parse_with_na(df[i,dS_idx]) : Float64(df[i,dS_idx])
        seqs = sort([s1,s2])
        key = join(seqs, " - ")
        if haskey(dict, key)
            old_nan = isnan(dict[key])
            new_nan = isnan(dS)
            if (old_nan && !new_nan) || 
                (!old_nan && new_nan) ||
                (!old_nan && !new_nan && dict[key] != dS)
                push!(errors, (key, "Conflict: existing dS=$(dict[key]), new dS=$dS"))
            end
        else
            dict[key] = dS
        end
    end
    if isempty(errors)
        return filter(row -> String(row[seq1_idx]) * " - " * String(row[seq2_idx]) in keys(dict), df)
    else
        println("Errors found:")
        for (key, msg) in errors
            println("  $key: $msg")
        end
        return nothing
    end
end

function format!(df::DataFrame)
    rename!(df, ["GeneID", "ParalogID", "dN", "dS", "Perc1", "Perc2"])
    df.dN = map(parse_with_na, df.dN)
    df.dS = map(parse_with_na, df.dS)
    df.Perc1 = map(parse_with_na, df.Perc1)
    df.Perc2 = map(parse_with_na, df.Perc2)
end
```

```{julia}
#| output: false

## Original (Ensembl 52-based) dN/dS values
human_ds_old = "../../dicty_data/mammals/primates/h_sapiens/Ensembl_99/paralog_info_GRCh38_ensembl_99.txt"
human_ds_new = "../../dicty_data/new_ds_human.csv"
dicty_ds_new = "../../dicty_data/new_ds_dicty.csv"
dicty_ds_old = "../../dicty_data/AX4/genome_ver_2_7/biomart/genes_v52/d_disc_paralogs_biomart_ensembl_protist_ver_52.txt"
dicty_fasta = "../../dicty_data/Dictyostelium_discoideum.dicty_2.7.pep.all.fa"
human_fasta = "../../dicty_data/mammals/primates/h_sapiens/Ensembl_115/Homo_sapiens.GRCh38.pep.all.fa"
dicty_filtered = "../../dicty_data/filtered/paralog_ds_filt.csv"
human_filtered = "../../dicty_data/filtered/human_paralog_info_filt.csv"
old_ds_cols_dicty = [1,15,3,4,5,6]
old_ds_cols_human = [1,11,5,6,7,8]
old_ds = human ? human_ds_old : dicty_ds_old
old_ds_cols = human ? old_ds_cols_human : old_ds_cols_dicty
new_ds = human ? human_ds_new : dicty_ds_new
oldds = CSV.read(old_ds, DataFrame)
select!(oldds, old_ds_cols)
format!(oldds)

## New YN00-based dN/dS values
newds = CSV.read(new_ds, DataFrame)
recs = []
fasta_file = human ? human_fasta : dicty_fasta
open(FASTA.Reader, fasta_file) do reader
    for rec in reader
        push!(recs, rec)
    end
end
pids = map(rec -> split(split(description(rec))[1], ".")[1], recs)
gids = map(rec -> split(split(split(description(rec))[4], ":")[2], ".")[1], recs)
ptog=Dict(zip(pids,gids))
gtop=Dict(zip(gids,pids))
filter!(row -> haskey(ptog, split(row.seq1, ".")[1]) && haskey(ptog, split(row.seq2, ".")[1]), newds)
insertcols!(newds, "GeneID" => map(id -> ptog[split(id, ".")[1]], newds.seq1))
insertcols!(newds, "ParalogID" => map(id -> ptog[split(id, ".")[1]], newds.seq2))
select!(newds, [31,32,3:30...,1,2])
select!(newds, [1,2,13,15,3,4])
format!(newds)
newds = newds |> filter(row -> row.Perc1 >= 30 && row.Perc2 >= 30)
if human
    CSV.write("../../dicty_data/mammals/primates/h_sapiens/new_ds_humans_filt.csv", newds)
end

## Create pair-order agnostic lookup tables for old and new dN/dS values
map_new = tomap(newds)
map_old = tomap(oldds)

## Original filtered pairs
old_pairs = CSV.read(human ? human_filtered : dicty_filtered, DataFrame)
select!(old_pairs, [1,2,5,6,3,4])
format!(old_pairs);
```

## Ensembl dS values vs. YN00 dS values
```{julia}
#| output: asis
#| echo: false
h1 = histogram(
    x = oldds.dS |> skipmissing |> filter(x -> x <=10) |> collect,
    histnorm="percent",
    name = "Old dS"
)
h2 = histogram(
    x = newds.dS |> skipmissing |> filter(x -> x <=1) |> collect,
    histnorm="percent",
    name = "New dS"
)
fig = make_subplots(rows=1,cols=2)
add_trace!(fig, h1, col=1)
add_trace!(fig, h2, col=2)
relayout!(fig, title="Distribution of old vs. new dS values$(human ? " (Human)" : " (D. discoideum)")", xaxis_title="dS", yaxis_title="Count")
fig.plot
```
## Spearman and Pearson correlation of Ensembl vs. YN00 dS values
### All new values from pairs matching old pairs
```{julia}
#| output: asis
old_in_new = [
    [("new",(map_new[row[1] * "-" * row[2]])), ("old",(row[3],row[4]))] 
    for row in eachrow(oldds) 
    if !ismissing(row[1]) && !ismissing(row[2]) && haskey(map_new,row[1] * "-" * row[2])
]
dS_new = [s[1][2][2] for s in old_in_new]
dS_old = [s[2][2][2] for s in old_in_new]
dN_new = [s[1][2][1] for s in old_in_new] 
dN_old = [s[2][2][1] for s in old_in_new]
ds_cors = getcors(dS_new, dS_old)
ds_corl = getcorl(dS_new, dS_old)
dn_cors = getcors(dN_new, dN_old)
dn_corl = getcorl(dN_new, dN_old)
println("""
| Correlation | Statistic | Value |
|-|-|-|
| ρ | dS | $ds_cors |
| r | dS | $ds_corl |
| ρ | dN | $dn_cors |
| r | dN | $dn_corl |
""")
```
